tool_schemas.name: superset_auth_check_token_validity
tool_schemas.description:
Check if the current access token is still valid

    Makes a request to the /api/v1/me/ endpoint to test if the current token is valid.
    Use this to verify authentication status before making other API calls.

    Returns:
        A dictionary with token validity status and any error information

tool_schemas.name: superset_auth_refresh_token
tool_schemas.description:
Refresh the access token using the refresh endpoint

    Makes a request to the /api/v1/security/refresh endpoint to get a new access token
    without requiring re-authentication with username/password.

    Returns:
        A dictionary with the new access token or error information

tool_schemas.name: superset_auth_authenticate_user
tool_schemas.description:
Authenticate with Superset and get access token

    Makes a request to the /api/v1/security/login endpoint to authenticate and obtain an access token.
    If there's an existing token, will first try to check its validity.
    If invalid, will attempt to refresh token before falling back to re-authentication.

    Args:
        username: Superset username (falls back to environment variable if not provided)
        password: Superset password (falls back to environment variable if not provided)
        refresh: Whether to refresh the token if invalid (defaults to True)

    Returns:
        A dictionary with authentication status and access token or error information

tool_schemas.name: superset_dashboard_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists dashboards the current authenticated Superset user can view and returns a paged result set using 1-indexed `page` and `page_size` (response includes the dashboards for that page plus Superset pagination metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `page`/`page_size` are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to list dashboards, and RATE_LIMITED if Superset rejects the request due to quota/too many requests.

page_size.description: Number of dashboards to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: superset_dashboard_get_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches full details for a single dashboard by `dashboard_id` and returns the dashboard record as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `dashboard_id` is not a valid integer, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot view the dashboard, and NOT_FOUND if no accessible dashboard exists with that id.

tool_schemas.name: superset_dashboard_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Superset dashboard with `dashboard_title` and optional `json_metadata`, returning the created dashboard (including its id and Superset-provided fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or `json_metadata` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to create dashboards, and CONFLICT if Superset rejects the create due to a uniqueness/constraint violation (for example, a conflicting slug/title policy).

tool_schemas.name: superset_dashboard_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing dashboard identified by `dashboard_id` with the provided `data` payload and returns the updated dashboard as returned by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `dashboard_id` is invalid or `data` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot edit the dashboard, NOT_FOUND if the dashboard does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the update is rejected due to a constraint violation (for example, slug conflicts).

tool_schemas.name: superset_dashboard_delete
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes the dashboard identified by `dashboard_id` and returns Superset’s deletion confirmation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `dashboard_id` is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to delete the dashboard, and NOT_FOUND if the dashboard does not exist or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: superset_chart_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists charts (slices) the current authenticated Superset user can view and returns a paged result set using 1-indexed `page` and `page_size` (response includes charts for that page plus Superset pagination metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `page`/`page_size` are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to list charts, and RATE_LIMITED if Superset rejects the request due to quota/too many requests.

page_size.description: Number of charts to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: superset_chart_get_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches full details for a single chart by `chart_id` and returns the chart record as provided by Superset, including visualization configuration fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chart_id` is not a valid integer, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot view the chart, and NOT_FOUND if no accessible chart exists with that id.

tool_schemas.name: superset_chart_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Superset chart using `slice_name`, `datasource_id`, `datasource_type`, `viz_type`, and `params`, returning the created chart (including its id and Superset-provided fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any required field is missing, `datasource_type` is unsupported, or `params` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to create charts, and NOT_FOUND if the referenced datasource cannot be found or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: superset_chart_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing chart identified by `chart_id` with the provided `data` payload and returns the updated chart as returned by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chart_id` is invalid or `data` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot edit the chart, NOT_FOUND if the chart does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the update is rejected due to a constraint or incompatible state.

tool_schemas.name: superset_chart_delete
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes the chart identified by `chart_id` and returns Superset’s deletion confirmation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chart_id` is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to delete the chart, and NOT_FOUND if the chart does not exist or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists Superset database connections the current user can access and returns a paginated result set for the requested page/page_size, including each database’s basic metadata (for example id, name, and configuration summary where allowed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page or page_size are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to list databases, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

page_size.description: Number of databases to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_get_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches full details for a single Superset database by database_id and returns the database record (including configuration fields that the caller is permitted to view). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is not a positive integer, NOT_FOUND if no database with that id exists or it is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to read database details.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Superset database connection using the provided engine, configuration_method, database_name, and sqlalchemy_uri, and returns the created database object (including its assigned id). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid or the configuration_method/engine is unsupported, CONFLICT if a database with the same identifying properties already exists (as enforced by Superset), UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to create databases, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_get_tables
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of tables visible in the specified database_id, including schema and table identifiers as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to browse tables for that database, and BAD_GATEWAY if Superset cannot reach the underlying database to enumerate tables.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_schemas
tool_schemas.description: Lists schemas available in the specified database_id and returns a collection of schema names from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to browse schemas for that database, and BAD_GATEWAY if Superset cannot reach the underlying database to enumerate schemas.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_test_connection
tool_schemas.description: Tests a set of database connection parameters (database_data, including sqlalchemy_uri and related options) and returns the connection test result from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_data is missing required fields or contains unsupported values, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to run connection tests, and BAD_REQUEST if Superset rejects the connection parameters or the database cannot be reached/authenticated.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Superset database identified by database_id with the provided data fields and returns the updated database object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid or the update payload contains invalid/unsupported fields, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, CONFLICT if the update would violate Superset constraints (for example duplicate naming/identifiers), UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to edit the database.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the Superset database identified by database_id and returns the deletion result; this is permanent and may also remove dependent objects such as associated datasets as handled by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, CONFLICT if the database cannot be deleted due to existing dependencies or protected state enforced by Superset, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to delete databases.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_get_catalogs
tool_schemas.description: Lists catalogs available in the specified database_id and returns a collection of catalog names for engines that support catalogs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to browse database metadata, and BAD_GATEWAY if Superset cannot reach the underlying database to enumerate catalogs.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_get_connection
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves connection information for the specified database_id and returns the connection details that Superset allows the caller to view. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to view connection details (including cases where sensitive fields are restricted).

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_get_function_names
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the list of SQL function names supported by the specified database and returns them as a list in a response object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is not a valid integer, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the Superset instance or the database, and NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_get_related_objects
tool_schemas.description: Returns counts and references for charts and dashboards that depend on the specified database. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the Superset instance or database metadata, and NOT_FOUND if the database cannot be found.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_validate_sql
tool_schemas.description: Validates the provided SQL string against the specified database and returns the validation outcome (including any error messages returned by Superset). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sql is empty/invalid or database_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to validate SQL for that database, and NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: superset_database_validate_parameters
tool_schemas.description: Validates the supplied database connection parameters without creating a database and returns the validation result from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters is missing or not an object, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to validate connection parameters.

tool_schemas.name: superset_dataset_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists datasets the current user can view and returns a paged result set controlled by page (1-indexed) and page_size. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page/page_size are not valid integers or are out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the Superset instance or dataset listing.

page_size.description: Number of datasets to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: superset_dataset_get_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches full details for a single dataset, including available columns and metrics, and returns the dataset record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if dataset_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view the dataset, and NOT_FOUND if no dataset exists with that id.

tool_schemas.name: superset_dataset_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new dataset for the given database_id and table_name (optionally schema and owners) and returns the created dataset record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including owners not being an array of integers), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create datasets or access the target database, NOT_FOUND if the referenced database does not exist, and CONFLICT if a dataset for the same database/table/schema already exists.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def superset_dataset_create(table_name, database_id, schema=None, owners=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid, random
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0123000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0123000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "superset_dataset_create"
    credential_used = None

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, error=None, extra=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        row = {
            "id": "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential_used": credential_used,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "timestamp": _now(),
        }
        if error is not None:
            row["error"] = error
        if extra:
            row.update(extra)
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(table_name, str) or not table_name.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "table_name must be a non-empty string", field="table_name")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(database_id, int):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "database_id must be an integer", field="database_id")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if database_id <= 0:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "database_id must be a positive integer", field="database_id")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if schema is not None and (not isinstance(schema, str) or not schema.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "schema must be a non-empty string when provided", field="schema")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if owners is not None:
        if not isinstance(owners, list) or any((not isinstance(x, int)) for x in owners):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "owners must be an array of integers", field="owners")
            _log("error", e["error"])
            return e

    instances = _load("superset_instances.json")
    active = [r for r in instances if r.get("status") == "active"]
    if not active:
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active Superset instance is configured")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if not s or not isinstance(s, str): 
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s[:-1])
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    active.sort(key=lambda r: (_parse_dt(r.get("created_at")) or datetime.datetime.max, r.get("id") or ""))
    instance = active[0]
    instance_id = instance.get("id")

    assets = _load("superset_assets.json")

    # Find referenced database asset (must be asset_type='database' and not deleted)
    db_asset = None
    for a in assets:
        if a.get("superset_instance_id") == instance_id and a.get("asset_type") == "database" and a.get("superset_object_id") == database_id:
            if a.get("status") != "deleted":
                db_asset = a
                break
    if not db_asset:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", f"Database {database_id} not found", database_id=database_id)
        _log("error", e["error"], {"superset_instance_id": instance_id})
        return e

    # Choose a new superset_object_id for dataset (simulate Superset create)
    existing_ids = set()
    for a in assets:
        if a.get("superset_instance_id") == instance_id and a.get("asset_type") == "dataset" and isinstance(a.get("superset_object_id"), int):
            existing_ids.add(a["superset_object_id"])
    # deterministic-ish: next integer after max; if none, start at 1
    new_id = (max(existing_ids) + 1) if existing_ids else 1

    # Upsert by unique(superset_instance_id, asset_type, superset_object_id)
    now = _now()
    payload = {
        "database_id": database_id,
        "table_name": table_name.strip(),
        "schema": schema.strip() if isinstance(schema, str) else None,
        "owners": owners[:] if isinstance(owners, list) else None,
        "columns": None,
        "metrics": None,
    }

    # attempt to find existing row with new_id (shouldn't exist); but also prevent duplicate "same db/table/schema" if already present:
    # (Not declared unique, but helps emulate real-world behavior a bit; if found active/stale, return conflict)
    for a in assets:
        if a.get("superset_instance_id") == instance_id and a.get("asset_type") == "dataset" and a.get("status") != "deleted":
            if (a.get("database_asset_id") == db_asset.get("id")
                and (a.get("table_name") or (a.get("payload") or {}).get("table_name")) == table_name.strip()
                and (a.get("schema_name") or (a.get("payload") or {}).get("schema")) == (schema.strip() if isinstance(schema, str) else None)):
                e = _err("CONFLICT", "A dataset for this database/table/schema already exists", database_id=database_id, table_name=table_name.strip(), schema=(schema.strip() if isinstance(schema, str) else None))
                _log("error", e["error"], {"superset_instance_id": instance_id})
                return e

    new_asset = {
        "id": "asset_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
        "superset_instance_id": instance_id,
        "asset_type": "dataset",
        "superset_object_id": new_id,
        "superset_key": None,
        "name": table_name.strip(),
        "slug": None,
        "database_asset_id": db_asset.get("id"),
        "dataset_asset_id": None,
        "schema_name": schema.strip() if isinstance(schema, str) else None,
        "table_name": table_name.strip(),
        "datasource_type": None,
        "viz_type": None,
        "payload": payload,
        "owners": owners[:] if isinstance(owners, list) else None,
        "status": "active",
        "last_synced_at": now,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    assets.append(new_asset)
    _save("superset_assets.json", assets)

    resp = {
        "dataset": new_asset,
        "superset_instance": {
            "id": instance.get("id"),
            "base_url": instance.get("base_url"),
            "api_prefix": instance.get("api_prefix"),
        },
    }
    _log("ok", None, {"superset_instance_id": instance_id, "created_dataset_id": new_id})
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: superset_sqllab_execute_query
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided SQL against the specified database via SQL Lab and returns the execution response (including identifiers needed to inspect results in subsequent calls). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sql is empty/invalid or database_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot execute queries on that database, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the Superset instance rejects execution due to configured limits.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def superset_sqllab_execute_query(database_id, sql, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0123000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0123000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "superset_sqllab_execute_query"
    credential_used = None

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, error=None, extra=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        row = {
            "id": "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential_used": credential_used,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "timestamp": _now(),
        }
        if error is not None:
            row["error"] = error
        if extra:
            row.update(extra)
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(database_id, int):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "database_id must be an integer", field="database_id")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if database_id <= 0:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "database_id must be a positive integer", field="database_id")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(sql, str) or not sql.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "sql must be a non-empty string", field="sql")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e

    instances = _load("superset_instances.json")
    active = [r for r in instances if r.get("status") == "active"]
    if not active:
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active Superset instance is configured")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if not s or not isinstance(s, str): 
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s[:-1])
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    active.sort(key=lambda r: (_parse_dt(r.get("created_at")) or datetime.datetime.max, r.get("id") or ""))
    instance = active[0]
    instance_id = instance.get("id")

    assets = _load("superset_assets.json")
    db_asset = None
    for a in assets:
        if a.get("superset_instance_id") == instance_id and a.get("asset_type") == "database" and a.get("superset_object_id") == database_id and a.get("status") != "deleted":
            db_asset = a
            break
    if not db_asset:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", f"Database {database_id} not found", database_id=database_id)
        _log("error", e["error"], {"superset_instance_id": instance_id})
        return e

    # Quota enforcement (simple): max 200 execute calls per UTC day per instance.
    logs = _load("request_logs.json")
    today = datetime.datetime.utcnow().date().isoformat()
    used_today = 0
    for r in logs:
        if r.get("endpoint") == endpoint and r.get("status") == "ok" and r.get("superset_instance_id") == instance_id:
            ts = r.get("timestamp")
            if isinstance(ts, str) and ts[:10] == today:
                used_today += 1
    if used_today >= 200:
        e = _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily SQL execution quota exceeded", quota_daily=200, used_today=used_today)
        _log("error", e["error"], {"superset_instance_id": instance_id})
        return e

    queries = _load("sql_lab_queries.json")
    now = _now()

    # Create row with status='queued'
    q_id = "sqlq_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    client_id = "cli_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    result_key_seed = f"{instance_id}:{database_id}:{client_id}:{sql.strip()}".encode("utf-8")
    result_key = "res_" + hashlib.sha256(result_key_seed).hexdigest()[:32]

    # Uniques: (superset_instance_id, client_id) and result_key
    if any(q.get("superset_instance_id") == instance_id and q.get("client_id") == client_id for q in queries):
        client_id = "cli_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    if any(q.get("superset_instance_id") == instance_id and q.get("result_key") == result_key for q in queries):
        result_key = "res_" + uuid.uuid4().hex

    row = {
        "id": q_id,
        "superset_instance_id": instance_id,
        "database_asset_id": db_asset.get("id"),
        "saved_query_asset_id": None,
        "superset_query_id": None,
        "client_id": client_id,
        "result_key": result_key,
        "sql": sql.strip(),
        "schema_name": None,
        "cost_estimate": None,
        "results_preview": None,
        "row_count": None,
        "duration_ms": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "status": "queued",
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    queries.append(row)
    _save("sql_lab_queries.json", queries)

    # Simulate Superset response and lifecycle transitions: queued -> running -> success/failed
    started = _now()
    row["status"] = "running"
    row["started_at"] = started
    row["updated_at"] = started

    # Determine outcome (very light simulation): if SQL contains forbidden/obviously invalid patterns -> failed.
    sql_upper = sql.strip().upper()
    failed = False
    err_msg = None
    if ";" in sql_upper.strip().rstrip(";") and sql_upper.count(";") > 1:
        failed = True
        err_msg = "Multiple statements are not allowed"
    if sql_upper.startswith("DROP ") or sql_upper.startswith("DELETE ") or sql_upper.startswith("TRUNCATE "):
        failed = True
        err_msg = "Statement type not allowed via this integration"

    finished = _now()
    if failed:
        row["status"] = "failed"
        row["error_message"] = err_msg
        row["duration_ms"] = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        row["finished_at"] = finished
        row["updated_at"] = finished
    else:
        row["status"] = "success"
        row["duration_ms"] = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        row["row_count"] = 0
        row["results_preview"] = {"columns": [], "rows": []}
        row["finished_at"] = finished
        row["updated_at"] = finished

    # Persist updated row
    queries = _load("sql_lab_queries.json")
    for i, q in enumerate(queries):
        if q.get("id") == q_id:
            queries[i] = row
            break
    _save("sql_lab_queries.json", queries)

    resp = {
        "query": row,
        "identifiers": {
            "client_id": client_id,
            "result_key": result_key,
        },
        "superset_instance": {
            "id": instance.get("id"),
            "base_url": instance.get("base_url"),
            "api_prefix": instance.get("api_prefix"),
        },
    }
    _log("ok", None, {"superset_instance_id": instance_id, "database_id": database_id, "query_id": q_id})
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: superset_saved_query_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new saved query in Superset from `query_data` and returns the created saved query record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query_data` is missing required fields or fails Superset validation (for example invalid database/schema references), UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot create saved queries or lacks access to the referenced database, and NOT_FOUND if referenced resources (such as the database id) do not exist or are not accessible.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def superset_saved_query_create(query_data, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0123000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0123000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, superset_instance_id=None, auth_session_id=None, error_code=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if isinstance(logs, list):
            logs.append({
                "id": "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
                "endpoint": "superset_saved_query_create",
                "superset_instance_id": superset_instance_id,
                "auth_session_id": auth_session_id,
                "status": status,
                "error_code": error_code,
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
                "created_at": now
            })
            _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(query_data, dict):
        _log("error", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "`query_data` must be an object.", field="query_data")

    # Basic required fields (Superset varies; enforce core)
    # Accept common keys: sql or query; label/name; database_id
    label = query_data.get("label") if isinstance(query_data.get("label"), str) else (query_data.get("name") if isinstance(query_data.get("name"), str) else None)
    sql = query_data.get("sql") if isinstance(query_data.get("sql"), str) else (query_data.get("query") if isinstance(query_data.get("query"), str) else None)
    database_id = query_data.get("database_id")
    schema_name = query_data.get("schema") if isinstance(query_data.get("schema"), str) else (query_data.get("schema_name") if isinstance(query_data.get("schema_name"), str) else None)

    missing = []
    if not label or not label.strip():
        missing.append("label")
    if not sql or not sql.strip():
        missing.append("sql")
    if not isinstance(database_id, int) or database_id <= 0:
        missing.append("database_id")
    if missing:
        _log("error", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Missing or invalid required fields in `query_data`.", missing_fields=missing)

    instances = _load("superset_instances.json")
    sessions = _load("auth_sessions.json")
    assets = _load("superset_assets.json")

    active_instances = [i for i in instances if isinstance(i, dict) and i.get("status") == "active" and isinstance(i.get("id"), str)]
    active_instances.sort(key=lambda r: ((r.get("created_at") if isinstance(r.get("created_at"), str) else ""), r.get("id")))
    chosen_instance = None
    chosen_session = None
    for inst in active_instances:
        inst_id = inst["id"]
        cand = [s for s in sessions if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("superset_instance_id") == inst_id and s.get("status") == "authenticated" and (s.get("access_token") or s.get("refresh_token"))]
        cand.sort(key=lambda r: ((r.get("created_at") if isinstance(r.get("created_at"), str) else ""), r.get("id") or ""))
        if cand:
            chosen_instance = inst
            chosen_session = cand[0]
            break

    if not chosen_instance or not chosen_session:
        _log("error", error_code="UNAUTHORIZED")
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No Superset session is available to create saved queries.")

    inst_id = chosen_instance["id"]
    sess_id = chosen_session.get("id")

    # Validate referenced database exists in local cache for this instance (best-effort Superset validation)
    db_asset = None
    for a in assets:
        if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("superset_instance_id") == inst_id and a.get("asset_type") == "database" and a.get("superset_object_id") == database_id and a.get("status") != "deleted":
            db_asset = a
            break
    if not db_asset:
        _log("error", superset_instance_id=inst_id, auth_session_id=sess_id, error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid `database_id`: database not found (or not accessible) in this instance cache.", field="database_id", database_id=database_id)

    # Create new Superset object id deterministically: max+1 within instance for saved_query
    max_id = 0
    for a in assets:
        if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("superset_instance_id") == inst_id and a.get("asset_type") == "saved_query":
            soid = a.get("superset_object_id")
            if isinstance(soid, int) and soid > max_id:
                max_id = soid
    new_superset_id = max_id + 1

    # Upsert keyed by (superset_instance_id, asset_type, superset_object_id)
    existing = None
    for a in assets:
        if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("superset_instance_id") == inst_id and a.get("asset_type") == "saved_query" and a.get("superset_object_id") == new_superset_id:
            existing = a
            break

    payload = dict(query_data)
    # normalize a couple of keys
    payload["label"] = label
    payload["sql"] = sql
    payload["database_id"] = database_id
    if schema_name:
        payload["schema"] = schema_name

    if existing:
        existing["name"] = label
        existing["schema_name"] = schema_name
        existing["database_asset_id"] = db_asset.get("id")
        existing["payload"] = payload
        existing["status"] = "active"
        existing["last_synced_at"] = now
        existing["updated_at"] = now
        saved_row = existing
    else:
        new_row = {
            "id": "sa_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "superset_instance_id": inst_id,
            "asset_type": "saved_query",
            "superset_object_id": new_superset_id,
            "superset_key": None,
            "name": label,
            "slug": None,
            "database_asset_id": db_asset.get("id"),
            "dataset_asset_id": None,
            "schema_name": schema_name,
            "table_name": None,
            "datasource_type": None,
            "viz_type": None,
            "payload": payload,
            "owners": query_data.get("owners") if isinstance(query_data.get("owners"), list) else None,
            "status": "active",
            "last_synced_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        assets.append(new_row)
        saved_row = new_row

    _save("superset_assets.json", assets)

    out = {
        "id": saved_row.get("superset_object_id"),
        "label": saved_row.get("name"),
        "sql": payload.get("sql"),
        "database_id": payload.get("database_id"),
        "schema": payload.get("schema"),
        "created_at": saved_row.get("created_at"),
        "updated_at": saved_row.get("updated_at"),
        "payload": payload
    }

    _log("ok", superset_instance_id=inst_id, auth_session_id=sess_id)
    return {"data": out}

tool_schemas.name: superset_query_stop
tool_schemas.description: Stops (cancels) a running SQL query identified by `client_id` and returns Superset’s confirmation payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `client_id` is missing/empty, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user is not allowed to stop the target query, NOT_FOUND if the `client_id` does not match any known query, and CONFLICT if the query is already finished and cannot be stopped.

tool_schemas.name: superset_query_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists SQL query executions from Superset query history and returns a paginated result set; pagination is controlled by `page` (1-based) and `page_size`, and results can be filtered/sorted using `search`, `status`, `order_column`, and `order_direction`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination values or unsupported sort/filter values, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, and FORBIDDEN if the user cannot access query history.

page.description: Page number of results to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of queries to return per page.

order_column.description: Column name to sort by as supported by Superset query listing.

order_direction.description: Sort direction for the query list.

search.description: Free-text search filter applied by Superset to query history.

tool_schemas.name: superset_query_get_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves detailed information for a single query execution by id and returns the full query execution record as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query_id` is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot view that query, and NOT_FOUND if the query id does not exist (or is not accessible).

tool_schemas.name: superset_activity_get_recent
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current user’s recent activity log as a paginated list; use `page` (1-based) and `page_size` to page through results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination values, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, and FORBIDDEN if the user cannot access recent activity.

page.description: Page number of recent activity items to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of recent activity items to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: superset_user_get_current
tool_schemas.description: Returns profile information for the currently authenticated Superset user, including identity and related account metadata Superset exposes. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available and FORBIDDEN if the Superset instance refuses access to the current-user endpoint for this account.

tool_schemas.name: superset_user_get_roles
tool_schemas.description: Returns the set of Superset roles assigned to the currently authenticated user by calling Superset’s /api/v1/me/roles/ and returning the role payload as provided by Superset. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid Superset session/token is available and FORBIDDEN when the Superset account is not permitted to access its own role listing; may also raise UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset is unreachable or returns a non-success response.

tool_schemas.name: superset_tag_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists tags from Superset’s /api/v1/tag/ and returns the page of tag records along with Superset’s pagination metadata; results are paged with 1-based page and page_size and can be sorted and searched using the provided fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when page/page_size are invalid (e.g., non-positive) or order_direction is not one of the allowed values, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot list tags in Superset. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset rejects the request (including invalid order_column/search syntax as enforced by Superset) or is unavailable.

page.description: Page number of tags to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of tags to return per page.

order_column.description: Column name to sort tags by as supported by Superset.

order_direction.description: Sort direction for the tag list.

search.description: Free-text search filter applied by Superset to tags.

tool_schemas.name: superset_tag_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Superset tag via /api/v1/tag/ (POST) and returns the created tag record as returned by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when name is missing/blank, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to create tags, and CONFLICT when Superset refuses the create due to a duplicate tag name or other uniqueness constraint. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side failures or connectivity issues.

tool_schemas.name: superset_tag_get_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tag by id from Superset’s /api/v1/tag/{id} and returns the tag details as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tag_id is not a valid integer identifier, NOT_FOUND when no such tag exists in Superset, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot view tags. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset returns an unexpected error or is unreachable.

tool_schemas.name: superset_tag_objects
tool_schemas.description: Returns Superset’s grouped view of tagged objects from /api/v1/tag/get_objects/, optionally filtered by object_type, and returns a single page of groups with Superset’s pagination metadata (1-based page and page_size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when page/page_size are invalid or object_type is not one of the supported values, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot read tag associations in Superset. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset rejects the request or is unavailable.

page.description: Page number of tagged object groups to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of tagged object groups to return per page.

object_type.description: Restrict results to a specific object type.

tool_schemas.name: superset_tag_delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a tag in Superset via /api/v1/tag/{id} (DELETE) and returns Superset’s deletion confirmation payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tag_id is not valid, NOT_FOUND when the tag does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to delete tags. Raises CONFLICT when Superset refuses deletion due to existing constraints or state, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side failures.

tool_schemas.name: superset_tag_object_add
tool_schemas.description: Associates an existing tag (by tag_name) to a Superset object identified by object_type and object_id, returning Superset’s response for the created association. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when object_type/object_id/tag_name are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND when the referenced object or tag cannot be resolved in Superset, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to edit tags on the target object. Raises CONFLICT when the association already exists or Superset refuses the change due to object state, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side errors.

tool_schemas.name: superset_tag_object_remove
tool_schemas.description: Removes the association between tag_name and the specified Superset object (object_type, object_id), returning Superset’s response for the removal. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND when the object, tag, or the association does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot modify tags on the target object. Raises CONFLICT when Superset refuses the change due to object state, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side failures.

tool_schemas.name: superset_explore_form_data_create
tool_schemas.description: Stores (or registers) Explore form_data via Superset’s /api/v1/explore/form_data (POST) and returns the generated key/descriptor that can be used to retrieve the same configuration later. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when form_data is missing or not an object, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot use Explore APIs in Superset. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset rejects the payload (e.g., invalid datasource/fields as enforced by Superset) or is unreachable.

tool_schemas.name: superset_explore_form_data_get
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves previously stored Explore form data from Superset’s /api/v1/explore/form_data/{key} and returns the saved configuration payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when key is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND when the key does not exist or has expired in Superset, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access Explore form data. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset returns a non-success response or is unreachable.

tool_schemas.name: superset_explore_permalink_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Superset Explore permalink by posting the provided Explore state (including form_data) and returns the created permalink payload (including the generated key/URL details from Superset). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if state is missing or not an object, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the Superset session is not authenticated or lacks permission to access Explore, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Superset rejects the state or returns an error response.

tool_schemas.name: superset_explore_permalink_get
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a previously saved Explore permalink state for the given key and returns the stored exploration state as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if key is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the permalink key does not exist (or is not accessible to the current user), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the Superset session is not authenticated or lacks permission to read the permalink.

tool_schemas.name: superset_menu_get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the current user’s Superset navigation menu structure from Superset and returns the menu items/configuration computed from that user’s permissions. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Superset authentication is available, FORBIDDEN if the authenticated user is not permitted to access menu metadata, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for non-success responses from Superset.

tool_schemas.name: superset_config_get_base_url
tool_schemas.description: Returns the configured base URL of the Superset instance this service is connected to. Raises NOT_CONFIGURED if no Superset base URL has been set for the current environment, and UNAUTHORIZED if access to integration configuration is restricted to authenticated callers.

tool_schemas.name: superset_advanced_data_type_convert
tool_schemas.description: Converts the provided value to the specified Superset advanced data type by calling Superset’s conversion endpoint and returns the converted representation from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if type_name is missing/empty or value is omitted, NOT_FOUND if the requested advanced data type is not recognized by Superset, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the Superset session is not authenticated or lacks permission to use the endpoint.

tool_schemas.name: superset_advanced_data_type_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists the advanced data types supported by the connected Superset instance and returns their names/configuration; when refresh=true, bypasses any local cache and refetches from Superset, otherwise a cached result may be returned. This endpoint is not paged. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the Superset session is not authenticated or lacks permission to read advanced data types, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Superset returns an error response.

refresh.description: Whether to bypass any local cache and fetch the latest advanced data types from Superset.

tool_schemas.name: superset_instance_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally-configured Superset instances, optionally filtered by lifecycle `status`, returning a paged result set (1-indexed `page`/`page_size`) ordered deterministically (oldest created first). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to view configured instances.

page_size.description: Number of instances to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: superset_instance_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates a locally-configured Superset instance identified by `id` and returns the updated instance record. Supports lifecycle state changes via `status` (active/disabled). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is invalid or payload is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if no instance exists with that id, and CONFLICT if enabling an instance violates server rules (e.g., multiple active instances when not supported).

base_url.description: Base URL of the Superset server (e.g., https://superset.example.com).

api_prefix.description: API prefix path for Superset (defaults to /api/v1).

verify_tls.description: Whether to verify TLS certificates when calling Superset.

default_timeout_ms.description: Default request timeout to Superset in milliseconds.

status.description: Lifecycle status transition for the instance.

tool_schemas.name: superset_auth_session_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses) a local auth session for a Superset instance and optionally authenticates immediately. Returns the stored auth session record (with tokens when authenticated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs, NOT_FOUND if `superset_instance_id` does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if Superset rejects the provided credentials.

superset_instance_id.description: Local Superset instance id to bind the session to.

username.description: Superset username to authenticate with. If omitted, an anonymous session is created.

password.description: Superset password to authenticate with (required when username is provided).

refresh.description: If true, attempts token validation/refresh before falling back to login when a session already exists.

tool_schemas.name: superset_auth_session_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates a local auth session identified by `id`, including driving lifecycle transitions such as revoke (authenticated→revoked) or clearing error back to anonymous. Returns the updated auth session. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions/payload, NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot manage sessions.

status.description: Set the lifecycle status. Use 'revoked' to explicitly revoke local/remote tokens when supported; use 'anonymous' to clear stored auth state after an error.

revoke_remote.description: If true and supported by the Superset deployment, attempts to revoke the remote session/token before marking locally revoked.

metadata.name: Superset Integration
metadata.description: This backend stores connection/auth state to a Superset instance plus locally-cached Superset resources (databases, datasets, charts, dashboards, tags) and SQL Lab query executions for listing, lookup, and lifecycle actions like create/update/delete/stop. It supports workflows such as authenticating
